datePolicy: Keep raw primary timestamp and Eastern date separately. Use verified releaseDate and mark +/-2 days ambiguous. Winter 1.1.3.0 rollout stays null.
rankingPolicy: Operator judgement, not creator measurement or game data.
finding: The community map provides dated question topics for L1101-L1104 source checks. It does not verify creator measurements or native game behavior.
limits: No video, audio or transcript downloaded.
Existing caption tracks were advertised; 13 corrected text responses were empty and two corrected metadata retries failed. New six items have advertised tracks but caption text was not requested.
Velocity/drop, sprint-to-fire, hit registration and swap remain direct topic gaps. ADS time, jump accuracy and flinch remain result gaps.
Secondary forum/Steam claims were excluded; JRlAENl05Ms primary author is Pvt_Rinzler.
Winter Offensive releaseDate remains null; titles and article dates do not repair rollout evidence.
